book.denominator: 150 unique, independently teachable/assessable knowledge or skill units stated in Watson & Williams §§9.1–12.3, printed pp217–300 (source extraction PDF pp233–316). End-of-chapter questions, glossary repetitions and Java/Python/VB-specific code are excluded unless they add a distinct Paper 2 skill.
book.full: Explicit explanation plus a worked or practice application sufficient to teach the unit.
book.partial: The idea appears, but application breadth, synthesis or explicit teaching is incomplete.
book.missing: No explicit teaching evidence found in the current learner lesson payloads.
book.formula: weighted coverage = (full + 0.5 × partial) / denominator; this measures content presence/depth, not predicted student marks.

method.syllabus: 93 atomic objective/note requirements split only where the syllabus names distinct outputs, constructs, structures or methods.
method.auxiliaryTaxonomyRule: Subskill, pattern and topic are crosswalk namespaces and are not scored as coverage denominators. Past-paper family retains the separately audited breadth classification.
method.idNotice: All coverageId values are internal stable crosswalk IDs; they are not official Cambridge objective or question codes.

localizationPolicy: Where the source audit supplied only one language, Gate A mirrors the source title into both localized fields and marks it pending curated VI; these internal titles must not be promoted to learner UI before localization review.
